$comment: Mutation-score floor for the Stryker gate (#74). stryker-config.json's thresholds.break MUST equal 'floor' — Stryker exits non-zero below it, failing the weekly stryker.yaml run, which auto-files an issue. Ratchet policy: the floor only moves UP, in a PR that shows the new sustained score; lowering it requires a written rationale in the same PR. History lives in this file's git log.

measured.environment: local win-x64, dotnet-stryker latest, Release unit suite (254 tests)

history.note: first real run (stryker.yaml had been a config-less no-op)

#176 pass: 18 behavioural killing tests (verify/recurse flags, exit codes, retention dir + boundary, report counts, filter order, sink defaults) + ignore-methods for Log*/WriteLine* — log-statement mutants are unassertable by design, excluding them turns the score into signal

survivorProfile: 61 survivors, led by ArchiveVerifier (18) and the services — dominated by leaveOpen:true argument booleans and similar equivalent-behaviour mutants (disposal semantics indistinguishable in context). Raising the floor past ~87 means hunting those case-by-case; check the HTML report from the weekly stryker.yaml artifact.
